page0.text:
The sun is setting, so today's training ends.
I'm practically at my limit, and I still have magecraft lessons from Tohsaka tonight.
I failed to land a blow on Saber like I'd hoped, but I should save at least some energy for tonight.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-21:page0:1

page1.text:
It's also my turn to prepare dinner tonight.
Saber went to wash up after me, so she won't be back for a while.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-21:page1:1

page2.text:
"I'm home! Oh, I see you're making dinner, Shirou.
Good, good. Admirable."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-21:page2:1

page3.text:
Fuji-nee bursts into the living room, practically a bundle of energy, and immediately dives onto a cushion on the floor.
Unlike Saber, who needs to sleep over half the day, Fuji-nee is like this all day, every day.
I bet it's no different when she's asleep.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-21:page3:1

page4.text:
"Hey Shirou! Can I have this apple?"
She's holding one of the many apples on the table.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-21:page4:1

page5.text:
"Sure. There are a bunch, as you can see. Everyone should eat three a day."
"Really? Then let's make an apple pie. And by 'we' I mean you."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-21:page5:1

page6.text:
Fuji-nee takes a casual bite of the apple as she makes her suggestion.
I had put some apples I'd already washed out on the table, but I guess she's not the sort to care.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-21:page6:1

page7.text:
"...What a waste of the get-well gift..."
Misunderstanding or no, shouldn't she be a little more considerate about the gift my friend gave me out of concern?
For once, I should give her a piece of my mind.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-21:page7:1
